REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. REGISTRY.
No. D 4543/3
Dixwell Road Station.
Date 29/11-33

Subject (in full) Further Report re Illegal functioning by Chapei Police.

Made by and Forwarded by Inspector Eva.

Sir,

Further to my report of the 23-11-33 in reference to above matter I beg to state that at about 10 pm. 27-11-33 a Chinese named Tsang Kwei Zien, 204 Scott Road was arrested by Chapei Police, in the Kyih Zeu Li off Scott Rd in connection with the seizure of a Moh-jong Set and money from 199 Scott Road. He was taken to 3/5 Division P.S.3. Station question and released at about 11-30 pm. 27-11-33. No fine was imposed. The alleyway in which this man was arrested can only be entered by crossing a Municipal Road.

At 9 am. 28-11-33 I visited Inspector S.Y. Wen 3/5 Division. P.S.3. and drew his attention to the illegal functioning of Officers attached to his Station on the Scott Road on the evening of the 27-11-33. He expressed his regrets that the incident had occurred but explained that they were done, during his absence on the instructions of his immediate subordinate. He also expressed his regret that his Officers had not immediately settled the matter on my calling at the Station on the night of 27-11-33. He stated that the Moh-jong Set and money would be returned.

At 1 pm. 28-11-33 Inspt. Wen call at Dixwell Road Rd Station and together with the undersigned visited the locations. An assurance was given by Inspt. Wen that his men would not function on Municipal Roads, that if at any time they wished to make any arrests in alleyways off Municipal Roads in Chinese Territory, but not accessible to Chapei Police, he would inform D'R. Stn.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案号：登记处。
编号 D 4543/3
狄思威路捕房。
日期 1933年11月29日

主题（全称） 关于闸北警察非法行使职权的进一步报告。

由伊娃（Eva）巡官撰写并呈报。

先生，

继我于1933年11月23日就上述事项提交的报告之后，谨此陈述：1933年11月27日晚10时许，一名名为曾桂贤（Tsang Kwei Zien，音译）、居住在斯科特路204号的华人，因涉及从斯科特路199号没收麻将一副及现金一事，被闸北警察在斯科特路旁的吉余里（Kyih Zeu Li，音译）逮捕。他被带至第三区第五分区第3派出所接受讯问，并于1933年11月27日晚11时30分左右获释。未处以罚款。该男子被捕的弄堂只能通过穿越一条工部局道路进入。

1933年11月28日上午9时，我拜访了第三区第五分区第3派出所的文S.Y.（S.Y. Wen，音译）巡官，提请他注意其所属警员于1933年11月27日晚在斯科特路非法行使职权的行为。他对发生此事表示遗憾，但解释说这是在他缺席期间，由其直属下属指示所为。他还对1933年11月27日晚我造访捕房时，其警员未能立即解决此事表示遗憾。他表示将归还麻将和现金。

1933年11月28日下午1时，文巡官来到狄思威路捕房，与本人一同视察了相关地点。文巡官保证，其手下不会在工部局道路上行使职权；如果任何时候他们希望在中国领土内、但闸北警察无法进入的、位于工部局道路旁的弄堂里实施逮捕，他将通知狄思威路捕房。

先生，
您顺从的仆人，

I opened the door and saw there were a Chapei Policeman dressed
in Uniform, and 2 others in foreign dresses. One of the foreign
dressed men remarked to me "The case reported at the Dixwell
Road Police Station had been fixed up and we would like to
invite you to go to our Station to take your statement. I
then accompanied them to the 3rd stn. 5th Div., where another
foreign dress-ed officer asked me if I was one of these who gambled
with Mahjong ... I answered "Yes". He asked "Do you
know all these who gambled with you?", when I replied that I
knew only the shop-keeper and the others were unknown to me.
Subsequently, he asked "Have you any knowledge about where is
Settlement and where is Chinese Territory?" My answer was "No"
He then released. The time I left the Chapei Police Station
was about 11.30p.m.

Tsang Kwei Zien.

以下为曾桂贤（Tsang Kwei Zien，音译）的供词，
苏州人，由H.H. Lieu于1933年11月28日
在狄思威路捕房录取，
由书记员H.H. Lieu翻译并口译

我叫曾桂贤，50岁，苏州人，
苦力，居住在斯科特路旁季徐里（Tsi Seu Li，音译）20号。
1933年11月27日下午3点20分左右，当我在斯科特路199号
的一家香烟店与店主及其另外两位朋友打麻将时，
突然有两名身穿制服的闸北警察走进店里，
陪同他们的还有一名穿西装的华人。他们一言不发，
拿走了桌上各种面额的所有现金，
放入各自的口袋，随后将从墙上取下的一顶草帽里
装入了整副麻将牌。然后他们离开了。据我的一位
朋友告诉我，在他们离开后，店主钱福堂（Zien Foh Daung，音译）
前往租界捕房报案，而我则回家睡觉。当晚约10点30分，
我听到有人敲门，打开门后，看到有一名身穿
制服的闸北警察，以及另外两名穿西装的人。其中一名
穿西装的人对我说：“在狄思威路捕房报案的事情已经
处理好了，我们想请你去我们的捕房录口供。”
随后我随他们前往第五分区第3派出所，另一名穿
西装的警官问我是否是那些打麻将赌博的人之一……
我回答“是”。他问“你认识所有和你一起赌博的人吗？”，
我回答说我只认识店主，其他人我不认识。
随后，他问“你知道哪里是租界，哪里是中国地界吗？”
我回答“不知道”。
然后我被释放。我离开闸北捕房的时间
大约是晚上11点30分。

曾桂贤。

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Zien Foh Daung
native of Zaushing taken by me Clerk H.H. Lieu
at D8 Well Road Stn on the 27-11-33 translated
and interpreted by H.H. Lieu.

My name is Zien Foh Daung, aged 35, a native of
Zaushing, M/shop-keeper of "Wu Zung Cigarette Shop" at No.
199, Scott Rd. and a S.M.C. Tax payer. At about 8.20 p.m.
on the 27th day of November 1933, whilst I was playing
Mahjong Cards with my 3 friends in my shop, there suddenly
came into my shop two Chapei Policemen all in uniform,
numbers unknown, accompanied by a foreign dressed Chinese,
who, I was sure, was also a Policeman, having been seen
signing other Chapei Police's conference books before.
They, without saying a single word, took away all the money
of various denominations on the table, to the total value
about $4.00, put them in their respective pockets, and later
kept whole set of Mahjong Cards in my straw hat which they
took from the wall. They then all left. As far as I
know, these two uniformed Policemen were usually on Post
duty on the corner of Ziang Tuh Road and Scott Road.
Afterwards I came to the Dixwell Road Police Station with
the Tax paper reporting all that had been occured. I
am quite certain that I could recognize these three men
(Policemen) that came to my shop, should I see them.
This is my true statement.

Zien Foh Daung.

Signed statement in Chinese with
Officer ¼ Dixwell Rd.

Statement of Incidents which have occurred on
Outside Roads between January 1, 1933 and
October 31, 1933.

1. January 3
A S.P.C. was escorting a Chinese female
suspected of larceny to Lootoo Road Station along
Robison Road, O.O.L. when he was stopped by Chapel
Police of the Robison Road Sub-Station, who demanded
him to hand the prisoner over to them. This request
was acceded to and the matter reported to Lootoo Road
Station, whereupon the Inspector in charge interviewed
the Inspector i/c of the sub-Station, who handed back
the prisoner and apologised for the behaviour of his
constables.

2. January 9
subject
Mr. Middleton, a British/, and his wife, were
walking along Great Western Road, O.O.L. when four
members of the Peace Preservation Corps stopped them,
and refused to allow them to proceed. They were held
up with a pistol and a rifle respectively. The matter
was reported to Bubbling Well Station by Mr. Middleton
and the Station representative went to interview the
Officer i/c the Peace Preservation Corps on Great
Western Road, who however denied any knowledge or
responsibility in the matter.

3. January 10
A male Chinese driving a m/car on Brenan
Road near Brenan Piece, O.O.L. knocked down a male
Chinese pedestrian causing serious injury. The
S.P.S. ambulance removed the injured party to the
Red Cross Hospital and the Chapel police removed the
driver to the 6th Division Police Station, where they
kept him detained inspite of the efforts of Bubbling
Well Station to have him handed to them.

4. January 20
A Chapel Policeman held up a foreigner
driving a H.car bearing Settlement license plate on
Rubicon Road, O.O.L. They detained him in the Poh
Sing Ching Police Station for over an hour, while
enquiring as to why the car did not bear a Chinese
license.

5. February 28
A member of the Japanese Landing Party
collided with and injured a Chinese female on Brenan
Road, O.O.L. The parties concerned in the accident
were both brought to the 6th Division Police Station
by the S.P.S. Police. The injured female was sent
to the Red Cross Hospital and the Japanese M/cyclist
allowed to go.

6. February 28
A Chinese female ran across Brenan Road, O.O.L.
in front of a C.O.C. Co. Bus and was knocked down by it.
The S.P.S. Police of the 6th Division Station sent the

1933年10月31日期间发生在
越界筑路地区的事件陈述。

1. 1月3日
一名华捕正沿罗宾森路（Robison Road，音译）越界筑路区，
护送一名涉嫌盗窃的中国女性前往卢图路（Lootoo Road，音译）捕房，
途中被罗宾森路分站的闸北警察拦下，
要求他将囚犯移交给他们。这一要求得到了满足，
此事向卢图路捕房报告，随后主管巡官会见了
该分站的主管巡官，后者交回了囚犯，
并为其警员的行为道歉。

2. 1月9日
主题
英国人米德尔顿（Middleton）先生及其夫人，
正沿大西路（Great Western Road）越界筑路区行走时，
被四名保安队成员拦下，
并拒绝让他们继续前行。他们分别被一把手枪
和一支步枪指住。米德尔顿先生向静安寺捕房（Bubbling Well Station）
报告了此事，捕房代表前去会见大西路保安队的主管警官，
但后者否认对此事有任何了解或责任。

3. 1月10日
一名中国男性在越界筑路区布伦南路（Brenan Road）
靠近布伦南片（Brenan Piece，音译）处驾驶汽车，
撞倒一名中国男性行人，造成重伤。
工部局警务处救护车将伤者送往红十字会医院，
闸北警察将司机带至第六分区捕房，
尽管静安寺捕房努力要求将其移交，
他们仍将其扣留。

4. 1月20日
一名闸北警察在越界筑路区鲁比孔路（Rubicon Road，音译）
拦下一名驾驶挂有租界牌照汽车的外国人。
他们在波星靖捕房（Poh Sing Ching Police Station，音译）
将其扣留了一个多小时，
同时询问为何该车没有悬挂中国牌照。

5. 2月28日
日本登陆部队的一名成员在越界筑路区布伦南路
撞伤一名中国女性。事故双方均由
工部局警务处警察带至第六分区捕房。
受伤女性被送往红十字会医院，
日本摩托车手被允许离开。

6. 2月28日
一名中国女性在越界筑路区布伦南路
跑过一辆中国公共汽车公司（C.O.C. Co.）的巴士前方，
并被该车撞倒。第六分区捕房的
工部局警务处警察将

the driver. The Inspector i/c Bubbling Well tried to
vain to have the driver handed over to the S.M.P.

7. March 8

Detectives from the Liu Koh Hsien depot of the
Public Safety Bureau arrested two Chinese on Jessfield
Road near Connaught Road, O.O.L. (Wanted on a charge
of armed robbery).

8. March 17

Chapei police entered a shop on Yu Yuen Road,
O.O.L. to arrest a Chinese. On the Chinese in question
stating he was quite willing to visit the Chapei Police
Headquarters of his own accord, provided he had an escort
of the S.M.P., the Chinese authorities desisted in their
efforts.

9. March 12

A foreign lady driving a M/car on Great Western
Road, O.O.L. knocked down a Chinese boy who chased a
ball across the Road and ran into her car. The B.P.S.
Police arrested the lady who was driving and brought
her to the nearby Sub-Station, where full particulars
were taken, after which she was allowed to go, and the
injured boy was sent to the Red Cross Hospital.

10. March 18

Three armed B.P.S. Police were seen to function
as street patrols on Edinburgh Road between Yu Yuen and
Brenan Roads, O.O.L. Three plain clothes B.P.S. police
were also seen functioning as a patrol on Kinnear Road
and Jessfield Road. When questioned as to the reason
for this intruding the officer i/c of the local sub-
Station stated that these patrols were being sent out
as a result of applications from residents in that
district sent to the B.P.S. for protection against armed
robberies.

11. March 22

Five armed B.P.S. Police patrolled outside the
Hotel "Ting" and on Yu Yuen Road, at about 8 p.m.

12. March 24

Police from the 6th Precinct Station arrested
the driver of a B.P.S. truck, for parking on Brenan Road
near Nanking Road, O.O.L. The driver was taken to the
Station i/c Bubbling Well and put under arrest.

受伤女性送往红十字会医院，并扣留了
司机。静安寺捕房的主管巡官试图
将司机移交给工部局警务处，但未成功。

7. 3月8日

公安局刘河县（Liu Koh Hsien，音译）分局的侦探
在越界筑路区康纳路（Connaught Road）附近的极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）
逮捕了两名中国人（因武装抢劫罪被通缉）。

8. 3月17日

闸北警察进入越界筑路区愚园路（Yu Yuen Road）
的一家商店逮捕一名中国人。鉴于该中国人表示
只要有工部局警务处人员陪同，他愿意自行前往
闸北警察总局，中国当局停止了行动。

9. 3月12日

一名外国女士在越界筑路区大西路驾驶汽车，
撞倒了一名追球过马路并撞上她汽车的
中国男孩。英捕（B.P.S. Police）逮捕了驾车的女士，
并将她带到附近的分站，在记录完详细情况后，
允许她离开，受伤的男孩被送往红十字会医院。

10. 3月18日

有人看到三名持枪的英捕在越界筑路区
愚园路与布伦南路之间的爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）
作为街道巡逻队执行职务。还看到三名便衣英捕
在金尼尔路（Kinnear Road）和极司菲尔路
作为巡逻队执行职务。当被问及侵入的原因时，
当地分站的主管警官表示，这些巡逻队是因该地区居民
向英捕提出保护以免受武装抢劫的申请而派出的。

11. 3月22日

晚上8点左右，五名持枪的英捕在“亭”酒店（Hotel "Ting"，音译）外
及愚园路上巡逻。

12. 3月24日

第六警区捕房的警察逮捕了一名英捕卡车的司机，
原因是其在越界筑路区南京路附近的布伦南路停车。
司机被带至静安寺主管捕房并被拘留。

13. March 27th
A Russian when driving a M/car on Hungjao
Road, C.O.L. knocked down a Chinese pedestrian, and was
arrested by the B.P.S. Police, and eventually sent to

A German schoolboy while cycling on Great
Western Road, C.O.L. knocked down a Chinese pedestrian.
On an argument following the B.P.S. Police brought

i/c Bubbling Well attended and the cyclist paying

15. March 30

17. April 2

side of the Road. The Inspector i/c Bubbling Well

secured his release.

18. April 3

traffic post shelter on the corner of Jessfield and
Columbia Roads, O.C.L.

一名俄国人驾驶汽车在越界筑路区域（C.O.L.）的虹桥路撞倒一名中国行人，被华界警务处（B.P.S.）警察逮捕，并最终被送往南市华界警务处总部作进一步查问。静安寺捕房督察长要求将此案移交给他处理，但遭到拒绝。

14. 3月29日
一名德国学童在越界筑路区域（C.O.L.）的大西路骑自行车时撞倒一名中国行人。随后发生争执，华界警务处（B.P.S.）警察将双方带至附近的分巡捕房，静安寺捕房督察长到场处理，骑车人支付赔偿金20.00元后，双方获释。

15. 3月30日
西摩路第二分巡捕房的警察在越界筑路区域（O.C.L.）的哥伦比亚路逮捕了一名汽车司机，该司机撞倒了两名人力车夫。尽管静安寺捕房督察长试图将案件移交至静安寺捕房，但华界警务处（B.P.S.）警官坚持将案件送往南市华界警务处总部作进一步查问。

16. 3月31日
晚上8点左右，由华界警务处（B.P.S.）警察组成的搜查队（包括1名副巡官、1名警长和4名巡捕）在越界筑路区域（O.C.L.）的极司菲尔路搜查人力车和行人。

17. 4月2日
第六区捕房的警察在越界筑路区域（O.C.L.）的兆丰公园路逮捕了中华汽车公司（C.M.C. Co.）的一名巴士司机，因其撞上了停在路边的一辆自行车。静安寺捕房督察长前往关押该司机的捕房，并使其获释。

18. 4月3日
公共安全局在越界筑路区域（O.C.L.）的兆丰公园路与哥伦比亚路转角处设立了一个伞形交通岗亭。

pages.en:
- 4 -

19. April 12
When a F/Sergt. from Bubbling Well Station
was arresting unlicensed hawkers on Edinburgh Road,
O.C.L., the M.P.S. Police attempted to assist him,
and eventually threw one hawker's goods into the
creek.

20. April 20
A Japanese driving a truck on Brenan Road,
O.C.L. knocked down a Chinese male pedestrian. Both
parties were brought by the M.P.S. Police to the 6th
Division Station, and particulars taken, after which
they were let go.

21. April 21
When a Chapei Fire Brigade truck travelling on
Hungjao Road, O.C.L. ran into a motor cycle, ridden by
two foreigners, one of whom was injured, the M.P.S.
Police seized the motor cycle and brought it to Sicawei
Sub-Station. Bubbling Well Station attempted to secure
the release, but the officer i/c of the Sub-Station
stated that the cycle would be sent to the M.P.S.
Headquarters for further enquiries to be made.

22. April 22
When a motor car knocked down and injured a
pedestrian on Hungjao Road, O.C.L., the M.P.S. Police
prevented the driver concerned from bringing the injured
party to Hospital, and escorted both the driver and
pedestrian to a nearby Sub-Station where full particulars
were taken. The case eventually handed over to Bubbling
Well Station on an application from the Inspector i/c.

23. April 23
A foreigner when driving a sidecar on Brenan Road,
O.C.L. knocked down a small boy. Police of the 6th
Division Station, M.P.S. took the boy and the driver
to the 6th Division Station. The foreigner agreed to
return later with $5 as compensation for the boy, as he
had no money on his person, and was released on that
understanding.

24. May 1
When a Japanese naval truck collided with and
injured two Chinese coolies on Edinburgh Road, O.C.L.,
M.P.S. Police took all concerned to the nearest Sub-
Station. The Inspector i/c of Bubbling Well Station
arrived at the Sub-Station and secured the release of the
driver.
pages.zh:
- 4 -

19. 4月12日
当静安寺捕房的一名外籍警长在越界筑路区域（O.C.L.）的爱丁堡路逮捕无照小贩时，华界警务处（M.P.S.）警察试图协助他，并最终将一名小贩的货物扔进河里。

20. 4月20日
一名日本人驾驶卡车在越界筑路区域（O.C.L.）的白利南路撞倒一名中国男性行人。华界警务处（M.P.S.）警察将双方带至第六区捕房，记录详情后予以释放。

21. 4月21日
当闸北消防队的一辆卡车在越界筑路区域（O.C.L.）的虹桥路上与一辆载有两名外国人的摩托车相撞，其中一人受伤时，华界警务处（M.P.S.）警察扣押了摩托车并将其带至西摩路分巡捕房。静安寺捕房试图争取释放，但该分巡捕房负责人称，摩托车将被送往华界警务处（M.P.S.）总部以作进一步调查。

22. 4月22日
当一辆汽车在越界筑路区域（O.C.L.）的虹桥路撞伤一名行人时，华界警务处（M.P.S.）警察阻止涉事司机将伤者送往医院，并将司机和行人护送至附近的一个分巡捕房，在那里记录了全部详情。后经静安寺捕房督察长申请，该案最终移交给静安寺捕房。

23. 4月23日
一名外国人驾驶带边车的摩托车在越界筑路区域（O.C.L.）的白利南路撞倒一名小男孩。华界警务处（M.P.S.）第六区捕房的警察将男孩和司机带至第六区捕房。该外国人因身上未带钱，同意稍后带回5元作为对男孩的赔偿，并在此谅解下获释。

24. 5月1日
当一辆日本海军卡车在越界筑路区域（O.C.L.）的爱丁堡路撞伤两名中国苦力时，华界警务处（M.P.S.）警察将所有相关人员带至最近的分巡捕房。静安寺捕房督察长到达该分巡捕房，并使司机获释。

pages.en:
- 5 -

25. May 5
When a S.P.C. was running after a Chinese cyclist on Edinburgh Road, O.O.L. to arrest him for assault on police and refusing to obey traffic signals, the fugitive ran to a B.P.S. Police constable on duty nearby for protection. The constable at once demanded that the S.P.C. bring their case to the B.P.S. Sub-Station.
Meanwhile a party of Police from Bubbling Well Station arrived and arrested the cyclist before he was taken to the Sub-Station.

26. May 14
Police from the 6th Division Station of B.P.S. arrested the driver of a motor bus which had knocked down a Chinese cyclist on Jessfield Road, O.O.L. The case was dealt with at the above station and both parties had been released on the arrival of a representative from Bubbling Well Station.

27. May 14
B.P.S. Police arrested a Chinese on Brenan Road, O.O.L., whom they suspected of being a pickpocket. The Officer i/c of the Sub-Station controlling that district denied all knowledge of the matter when approached by a representative from the Bubbling Well Station.

28. May 21
B.P.S. Police from Siccawei Sub-Station arrested the driver of a P.V.B. truck on Avenue Haig, after he had an accident with a public ricksha and injured the occupant. The case was handed over to Bubbling Well Station on a request being sent by Inspector i/c.

29. May 21
B.P.S. Police of the 6th Division Station arrested the driver of two motor cars which were involved in an accident on Edinburgh Road, O.O.L. The case was handed over to Bubbling Well Station on a request being made by the Inspector i/c.

30. May 25
A China General Insurance Company inspector and another person were having a fight on Nanking Road, O.O.L. because the former refused to allow the latter to board his car without paying. The B.P.S. Police who were summoned to the scene took action and the Chinese who had assaulted the inspector were taken into custody and questioned.
pages.zh:
- 5 -

25. 5月5日
当上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.P.C.）人员在越界筑路区域（O.O.L.）的爱丁堡路追赶一名中国骑车人，欲以袭击警察和不服从交通信号为由将其逮捕时，逃犯跑向附近正在执勤的一名华界警务处（B.P.S.）巡捕寻求保护。该巡捕立即要求上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.P.C.）人员将其案件带到华界警务处（B.P.S.）分巡捕房处理。与此同时，一批来自静安寺捕房的警察赶到，在该骑车人被带往分巡捕房之前将其逮捕。

26. 5月14日
华界警务处（B.P.S.）第六区捕房的警察逮捕了一名在越界筑路区域（O.O.L.）的兆丰公园路撞倒一名中国骑车人的公共汽车司机。该案在上述捕房处理，当静安寺捕房代表到达时，双方均已获释。

27. 5月14日
华界警务处（B.P.S.）警察在越界筑路区域（O.O.L.）的白利南路逮捕了一名涉嫌扒窃的中国人。当静安寺捕房代表前来询问时，管辖该地区的分巡捕房负责人否认知晓此事。

28. 5月21日
西摩路分巡捕房的华界警务处（B.P.S.）警察在海格路逮捕了一辆私人货车（P.V.B.）司机，此前该车与一辆公共人力车发生事故并致车内乘客受伤。经静安寺捕房督察长发出请求，该案移交给静安寺捕房。

29. 5月21日
华界警务处（B.P.S.）第六区捕房的警察逮捕了两辆在越界筑路区域（O.O.L.）的爱丁堡路发生事故的汽车司机。经静安寺捕房督察长提出请求，该案移交给静安寺捕房。

30. 5月25日
一名中国通用保险公司（China General Insurance Company）的检查员与另一人在越界筑路区域（O.O.L.）的南京路发生斗殴，原因是前者拒绝后者在不付费的情况下乘坐其汽车。被召至现场的华界警务处（B.P.S.）警察采取行动，将袭击检查员的中国人拘留并进行讯问。

pages.en:
- 6 -

31. June 2a
B.P.S. Police prevented the S.F.B. Ambulance from taking a boy to hospital after he had received injury from a Japanese motor cycle on Brenan Road, O.O.L. when the latter collided with him on June 2. Police from Bubbling Well Station attended and insisted that the S.F.B. Ambulance remove the boy to the Red Cross Hospital.

32. June 6th
An accident occurred on Brenan Road when a German truck driver knocked down a Chinese female on Brenan Road O.O.L. B.r.S. Police took the driver with the truck to the 6th Division Station. The Inspt. i/c Bubbling Well succeeded in getting the case handed over to him.

33. June 7th
While two J.P.C.s were taking particulars of an accident between a motor car and a pedestrian on Edinburgh Road, O.O.L., B.P.S. Police appeared and took the chauffeur and motor car together with the injured party to the 6th Division Station. The driver was fined $2.00 for breach of traffic regulations, and ordered to pay $1.00 compensation to the pedestrian. The Inspector i/c Bubbling Well Station informed the officer i/c of the 6th Division Station that he was functioning illegally but no apology was given.

34. June 18th
A motor truck driven by a Russian collided with a Chinese boy on Nanking Road, O.O.L. and injured his leg. The driver ran away but was arrested by pedestrians and handed over to members of the 2nd Sub-Station of the 6th Division, Shanghai. Col. Tan Ke Shio (in charge of the 6th Division Station) refused to hand over the case to Bubbling Well Station.

35. June 19th
An accident occurred on Nanking Road, O.O.L. between a S.S.C. Co. bus and a small Chinese boy. B.P.S. Police from Nanking Sub-Station arrested the driver and sent the boy to the Shanghai Sanatorium. The boy was operated on at once and later removed by a S.F.B. Ambulance to the Lester Chinese Hospital where he died on the same night. Bubbling Well Station obtained the release of the driver on a promise being given by Mr. King of S.S.C. Co. to produce him when required at B.P.S. Headquarters. On the appearance of the driver on June 27 at B.P.S. Headquarters he was detained immediately pending the result of the trial.
pages.zh:
- 6 -

31. 6月2日a
华界警务处（B.P.S.）警察阻止上海法商电车公司（S.F.B.）救护车将一名男孩送往医院，该男孩于6月2日在越界筑路区域（O.O.L.）的白利南路被一辆日本摩托车撞伤。静安寺捕房的警察到场，并坚持要求上海法商电车公司（S.F.B.）救护车将该男孩送往红十字会医院。

32. 6月6日
越界筑路区域（O.O.L.）的白利南路发生一起事故，一名德国卡车司机撞倒一名中国妇女。华界警务处（B.r.S.，原文如此）警察将司机连同卡车带至第六区捕房。静安寺捕房督察长成功使该案移交给他处理。

33. 6月7日
当两名日本领事馆警察（J.P.C.s）在越界筑路区域（O.O.L.）的爱丁堡路记录一起汽车与行人之间的事故详情时，华界警务处（B.P.S.）警察出现，并将司机、汽车以及伤者一同带至第六区捕房。司机因违反交通法规被罚款2.00元，并被责令向行人支付1.00元赔偿金。静安寺捕房督察长通知第六区捕房负责人其行为非法，但未得到道歉。

34. 6月18日
一名俄国人驾驶的卡车在越界筑路区域（O.O.L.）的南京路撞伤一名中国男孩的腿部。司机逃逸，但被行人逮捕并移交给上海第六区第二分巡捕房成员。谭克修上校（Col. Tan Ke Shio，第六区捕房负责人）拒绝将案件移交给静安寺捕房。

35. 6月19日
越界筑路区域（O.O.L.）的南京路发生一起上海电车公司（S.S.C. Co.）巴士与一名中国小男孩之间的事故。南京路分巡捕房的华界警务处（B.P.S.）警察逮捕了司机，并将男孩送往上海疗养院（Shanghai Sanatorium）。男孩立即接受手术，随后由上海法商电车公司（S.F.B.）救护车转送至莱斯德华人医院（Lester Chinese Hospital），并于当晚死亡。鉴于上海电车公司（S.S.C. Co.）的金先生（Mr. King）承诺在华界警务处（B.P.S.）总部需要时提传司机，静安寺捕房使司机获释。6月27日司机出现在华界警务处（B.P.S.）总部时，随即被拘留，等待审判结果。

pages.en:
- 7 -

36. June 24th
A foreign Sergt. of the S.M.P. driving a motor car on Warren Road, O.O.L. in plain clothes and off duty, knocked down a female Chinese pedestrian. Members of the Bureau of Public Safety brought all concerned to the 6th Division Station where full particulars were taken after which the foreigner was released and the female was sent to hospital.

37. July 1st
A German lady driving a motor car, knocked down a Chinese youth who was playing on Avenue Haig, O.O.L. near Jordan Avenue. Members of the B. .S. accompanied her to the Red Cross Hospital where she brought the injured party in her car, and were about to bring her to the Siccawei Station when a party of Police from B'Well Station arrived at the hospital and prevented them from doing so.

38. July 2nd
An accident occurred on Nanghao Road, O.C.L. between a motor car and a Chinese pedestrian. B.P.S. Police attended and sent the injured party to the Red Cross Hospital in the B.P.S. Ambulance. A party of police from B'Well Station arrived and escorted the chauffeur to the Siccawei Station, where full particulars were taken, after which the chauffeur was released.

39. July 2nd
A foreign Sergt. from Bubbling Well Station was attempting to arrest a hawker on Edinburgh Road, O.O.L. when the latter called on a nearby Chapel Police constable for assistance. A foreigner who was passing in a motor car offered to take the hawker in his car to Bubbling Well Station. The Chapel constable also boarded the motor car and demanded that the foreigner should drive to the B.P.S. Sub-Station. The driver however drove straight into B'Well Station, where the case was settled by the S.M.P., the Chapel policeman being told that he was functioning illegally.

40. July 5th
Chapel Police brought two Chinese cyclists who had collided with each other on Bubbling Road, I.S.L. to the 6th Division Station. Full particulars were taken and both persons released.

41. July 10th
B.P.S. Police from the 7th Sub-Division Sub-Station arrested the driver of a motor lorry who knocked down a Chinese female on Nanking Road, O.O.L. and took him and his lorry to the Siccawei Station, the female being sent to St. Elizabeth Hospital.
pages.zh:
- 7 -

36. 6月24日
上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）的一名外籍警长便衣下班期间，在越界筑路区域（O.O.L.）的愚园路驾驶汽车撞倒一名中国女行人。公共安全局人员将所有相关人员带至第六区捕房，在记录全部详情后，该外国人获释，女子被送往医院。

37. 7月1日
一名德国女士驾驶汽车，在越界筑路区域（O.O.L.）的海格路靠近胶州路处撞倒一名正在玩耍的中国青年。华界警务处（B. .S.，原文不清）人员陪同她前往红十字会医院，她用私家车将伤者送至该院，正当他们准备将她带至西摩路捕房时，一批来自静安寺捕房（B'Well Station）的警察到达医院并阻止了这一行动。

38. 7月2日
越界筑路区域（O.C.L.）的南壕路（Nanghao Road，音译）发生一起汽车与中国行人之间的事故。华界警务处（B.P.S.）警察到场，并用华界警务处（B.P.S.）救护车将伤者送往红十字会医院。一批来自静安寺捕房（B'Well Station）的警察赶到，将司机护送至西摩路捕房，在那里记录了全部详情，随后司机获释。

39. 7月2日
静安寺捕房的一名外籍警长试图在越界筑路区域（O.O.L.）的爱丁堡路逮捕一名小贩，此时小贩向附近教堂捕房（Chapel Police）的一名巡捕求助。一名路过的外国人驾驶汽车提出载小贩去静安寺捕房。教堂捕房的巡捕也上了这辆汽车，并要求该外国人开车去华界警务处（B.P.S.）分巡捕房。然而，司机直接开进了静安寺捕房（B'Well Station），该案由上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）解决，教堂警察被告知其行为非法。

40. 7月5日
教堂警察将两名在越界筑路区域（I.S.L.）的卜罗得路（Bubbling Road，音译）相互碰撞的中国骑车人带至第六区捕房。记录全部详情后，两人获释。

41. 7月10日
第七分区分巡捕房的华界警务处（B.P.S.）警察逮捕了一名在越界筑路区域（O.O.L.）的南京路撞倒一名中国妇女的卡车司机，并将他和他的卡车带至西摩路捕房，该妇女被送往圣伊丽莎白医院（St. Elizabeth Hospital）。

pages.en:
- 8 -

42. July 20
Chapei Police from the 6th Division Station arrested
a . . . chauffeur who had knocked down a Chinese child on
Brenan Road, O.C.L. while driving a F.O.D. truck. The
driver signed a bond agreeing to pay the hospital expenses
of the injured party, and was consequently released.
Bubbling Well Station sent a representative to the 6th
Division Station later.

43. August 1
with
Chinese Merchant Volunteers armed rifles effected
a search party patrol on Hungjao Road near Chungann Road,
O.C.L. at about 10 p.m.

44. August 16
Chinese Authorities (apparently members of the
Peace Reservation Corps) held a search party on Hungjao
Road and Fraser Road corner, C.C.L. at about 10 p.m.

45. August 18
-do-

46. August 24
S.P.S. Police from Robison Road Sub-Station
attempted to arrest a Chinese chauffeur for driving on
Robison Road, O.C.L. without a Chinese license. On
the Chapei Policeman getting into the motor car the driver
drove straight to the Bubbling Well Station where the
Chapei Policeman was informed that he had been functioning
on a Municipal Road.

47) August 26
Three Chapei Merchant Volunteers arrested a
driver of a motor truck who had knocked down a pedestrian
on Warren Road, O.C.L. and brought him with the truck to the
6th Division Station. The accident proved fatal, and the
case was transferred to the S.P.S. Headquarters.

48) September 14
Members of the Merchant Volunteer arrested a C.P.C.
from Bubbling Well Station when he was attempting to
disperse a crowd on Columbia Road Bridge, O.C.L. and
dragged him forcibly to the Headquarters at Pah Hsin Village.
B'Well Station lodged a complaint and the officer i/c
of the Headquarters of the Merchant Volunteers promised
to deal severely with those responsible. The C.P.C. was
treated in the Police Hospital for abrasions of the knee.
pages.zh:
- 8 -

42. 7月20日
第六区捕房的闸北警察逮捕了一名……司机，该司机在越界筑路区域（O.C.L.）的白利南路驾驶一辆F.O.D.（原文缩写，含义不明）卡车时撞倒一名中国儿童。司机签署具结书，同意支付伤者的医院费用，因此获释。静安寺捕房随后派代表前往第六区捕房。

43. 8月1日
中国商团武装步枪队在晚上10点左右于越界筑路区域（O.C.L.）虹桥路近中安路（Chungann Road，音译）一带进行搜查巡逻。

44. 8月16日
中国当局（似乎是和平维持团成员）在晚上10点左右于中央捕房辖区（C.C.L.）的虹桥路与弗雷泽路转角处举行搜查行动。

45. 8月18日
同上

46. 8月24日
罗宾森路分巡捕房的上海特别市警察局（S.P.S.）警察试图以无中国执照在越界筑路区域（O.C.L.）的罗宾森路驾驶为由，逮捕一名中国司机。当闸北警察进入汽车时，司机直接开往静安寺捕房，在那里告知该闸北警察其行为发生在工部局道路上。

47) 8月26日
三名闸北商团成员逮捕了一名在越界筑路区域（O.C.L.）的愚园路撞倒行人的卡车司机，并将他连同卡车带至第六区捕房。事故证明是致命的，案件移交给上海特别市警察局（S.P.S.）总部。

48) 9月14日
商团成员在越界筑路区域（O.C.L.）的哥伦比亚路桥试图驱散人群时，逮捕了一名来自静安寺捕房的中国巡捕（C.P.C.），并强行将其拖至八新镇（Pah Hsin Village，音译）总部。静安寺捕房提出投诉，商团总部负责人承诺严厉惩处责任人。该中国巡捕在警察医院接受膝盖擦伤治疗。

pages.en:
- 9 -

49) September 7
On an omnibus of the C.G.C. Co. stopping on
the bridge at the corner of Avenue Haig and Hungjao Road
corner to allow passengers to alight, B.P.S. Police
ordered the driver to move on and not to stop there.
The driver refused to obey this order and in consequence
was arrested and brought to the 2nd Branch Station
of the Siccawei Division. Bubbling Well obtained the
release of the driver later.

50) September 10
A foreigner driving a motor car on Hungjao
Road, C.C.L. collided with a public ricksha. He went of
his own accord to the Sub-Station of the B.P.S. with the
ricksha coolie where he was ordered to pay $7.00 compensation.

51) September 16
A B.P.S. Search Party, three in plain clothes
and two in uniform, with drawn pistols operated as a
search party on Penang Road between Kiaochoow and Robison
Roads, C.C.L. stopping and searching all pedestrians,
at about 7 p.m.

52) September 22
A public ricksha bumped into a Chinese boy
carrying a tin of boiling water, on Jessfield Road, C.C.L.
upsetting him and causing him to receive scalds on his
back. Members of the B.P.S. arrested the ricksha coolie
and brought him to the 6th Division Station where he
was detained. The B.P.S. refused to hand over the case
to Bubbling Well Station.

53) September 24
Chapei Police from the B.P.S. arrested a
foreign driver of a motor car who was involved in an
accident on Brenan Road. (A small boy received slight
bruises when falling down in front of the said motor
car whilst running across the road, but was not touched
by the car). The Chapei Police entered the car and
ordered the driver to drive to the nearby sub-station,
but instead he drove into B'Well Station. The case
was dealt with by B'Well Station. The B.P.S. constable
was told that he was functioning illegally.

54) October 1
While a foreigner (British subject) was attending
to a feeble Chinese who had been knocked down by his
friend when riding bicycle on Robison Road, C.C.L., members
of the Poh Sing Ching Sub-Station, B.P.S., arrested him
and brought him to their station where they detained him
for some considerable time while they took particulars
of the accident.
pages.zh:
- 9 -

49) 9月7日
一辆中英银公司（C.G.C. Co.）的公共汽车在海格路（Avenue Haig）与虹桥路（Hungjao Road）拐角处的桥上停车让乘客下车时，华界警务处（B.P.S.）警察命令司机驶离，不得在此停留。司机拒绝服从该命令，因此被捕并被带至徐家汇巡捕房（Siccawei Division）第二分巡捕房。静安寺巡捕房（Bubbling Well）随后促成了司机的释放。

50) 9月10日
一名外国人在中央中区（C.C.L.）虹桥路驾驶汽车撞上了一辆公共人力车。他自愿与人力车夫一同前往华界警务处（B.P.S.）的分巡捕房，在那里他被责令支付7.00元赔偿金。

51) 9月16日
晚上7点左右，一支由三名便衣和两名制服人员组成的华界警务处（B.P.S.）搜查队，手持出鞘手枪，在中央中区（C.C.L.）胶州路（Kiaochoow Road）与罗宾森路（Robison Road）之间的槟榔路（Penang Road）执行搜查任务，拦截并搜查所有行人。

52) 9月22日
在中央中区（C.C.L.）极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road），一辆公共人力车撞倒了一名提着开水罐的中国男孩，导致其摔倒并背部烫伤。华界警务处（B.P.S.）警员逮捕了人力车夫并将其带至第六巡捕房拘留。华界警务处（B.P.S.）拒绝将此案移交给静安寺巡捕房。

53) 9月24日
华界警务处（B.P.S.）的闸北警察逮捕了一名在布伦南路（Brenan Road）卷入事故的外国汽车司机。（一个小男孩在横穿马路时跑过该汽车前方摔倒，受轻微擦伤，但未被汽车碰到）。闸北警察进入车内，命令司机驶往附近的分巡捕房，但司机反而将车开进了静安寺巡捕房（B'Well Station）。该案由静安寺巡捕房处理。华界警务处（B.P.S.）的巡捕被告知其行为非法。

54) 10月1日
当一名外国人（英国臣民）在中央中区（C.C.L.）罗宾森路照料一名被其朋友骑自行车撞倒的体弱中国人时，华界警务处（B.P.S.）波辛泾（Poh Sing Ching）分巡捕房的警员将其逮捕并带至该巡捕房，在记录事故详情期间将其扣留了相当长的一段时间。

pages.en:
- 10 -

55) October 3

A Chinese motor cyclist knocked down a Chinese
female on Jessfield Road near Brenan Place, O.O.I. on
October 3, and was in consequence arrested by the B.P.S.
Police. Although B'Well Station attempted to get the
case transferred to their jurisdiction the B.P.S.
authorities refused; and fined the M/Cyclist $1.00 and
made him pay $4.00 compensation.

56) October 22

A male Chinese received fatal injuries when
he fell under the rear nearside wheel of a C.G.O. Co.
bus, through his trying to board it while it was in
motion on the corner of Brenan and Jessfield Roads,
O.O.I. on October 22. The S.J.B. ambulance attended
but was prevented from functioning by the B.P.S. police
of the 6th Division Station, who took the dying man in
a public ricksha to their Station. Later the S.J.B.
was called and the injured man taken to the Red Cross
Hospital, where he was pronounced dead on arrival.
In spite of two interviews by the representatives from
Bubbling Well Station, the B.P.S. authorities refused to
allow the S.M.P. to remove the dead body to the Public
Mortuary.

57) November 1st

Chapel Police entered private Lane No.668
Yu Yuen Road and seized a private ricksha standing
at owner's front door for not having a Chinese
licence.
Ricksha eventually released upon coolie obtaining
a Chinese licence.
No entry to lane from Chinese territory.
Chapel Police entered from Yu Yuen Road.

58) November 2nd

Motor Car Licence No.1712, driven by Miss Tucker,
Lane 509, House 101, Nanking Road, was turning out
out of the above lane on to Nanking Road when a Ford
Motor car proceeding east on Nanking Road collided
with it.
Chapel Police from a nearby sub-station refused
to allow either car to proceed until the parties had
filled in a Chinese Chapel Accident Report Form.

59) November 5th

A collision between two motor cars took place
Nanking Road when a Chevrolet of the Bureau of Public
Safety who was riding a bicycle on the Nanking Road,
suddenly swerved into the path of the above mentioned
Chevrolet car. The chauffeur gave the required signal
and applied his brakes but was unable to avoid the
collision. The bicycle rider was thrown to the ground
and sustained slight injuries. He was removed to the
Red Cross Hospital where he was treated and subsequently
discharged. The matter was reported to the Bureau of
Public Safety who stated that they would take the necessary
steps to prevent a recurrence of such accidents.
pages.zh:
- 10 -

55) 10月3日

10月3日，一名中国摩托车手在越界筑路区域（O.O.I.）布伦南坊（Brenan Place）附近的极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）撞倒了一名中国妇女，因此被华界警务处（B.P.S.）警察逮捕。尽管静安寺巡捕房（B'Well Station）试图将该案移交其管辖，但华界警务处（B.P.S.）当局予以拒绝；并对摩托车手罚款1.00元，责令其支付4.00元赔偿金。

56) 10月22日

10月22日，在越界筑路区域（O.O.I.）布伦南路与极司菲尔路拐角处，一名中国男子试图在一辆中英巴士公司（C.G.O. Co.）公共汽车行驶过程中登车，结果跌入该车左后轮下，受致命伤。圣约翰救护队（S.J.B.）救护车赶到现场，但被第六巡捕房的华界警务处（B.P.S.）警察阻止执行职务，后者用一辆公共人力车将垂死者带至其巡捕房。随后圣约翰救护队（S.J.B.）再次被召来，伤者被送往红十字会医院，抵达时被宣布死亡。尽管静安寺巡捕房代表进行了两次交涉，华界警务处（B.P.S.）当局仍拒绝允许工部局警务处（S.M.P.）将尸体移至公立殓房。

57) 11月1日

闸北警察进入愚园路（Yu Yuen Road）668弄私人里弄，扣押了一辆停在业主前门口、未持有中国执照的私人人力车。
在车夫取得中国执照后，人力车最终获释。
无从中国领土进入该里弄的入口。
闸北警察从愚园路进入。

58) 11月2日

车牌号为1712的汽车，由住在南京路509弄101号的塔克小姐（Miss Tucker）驾驶，在从上述里弄驶出进入南京路时，与一辆在南京路上向东行驶的福特汽车相撞。
附近分巡捕房的闸北警察在两方当事人填写中方闸北事故报告表之前，禁止任何车辆通行。

59) 11月5日

南京路上发生两辆汽车相撞事故，当时公安局（Bureau of Public Safety）的一名骑自行车的人员在南京路上突然转向，切入上述雪佛兰汽车的路径。司机发出规定信号并刹车，但未能避免碰撞。骑车人被甩到地上，受轻伤。他被送往红十字会医院接受治疗，随后出院。此事已报告给公安局，该局表示将采取必要措施防止此类事故再次发生。

pages.en:
- 11 -

60) November 9th

A Sikh Constable on duty at Yu Yuen Road and Edinburgh Road while arresting two public ricksha coolies for not having Settlement licenses was interfered with by a constable of the Bureau of Public Safety. After the Municipal officer had returned to his post, he was threatened with a rifle by the constable of the Bureau of Public Safety.

An armed search party from the Bureau of Public Safety consisting of three men in uniform and three in plain clothes operated on Jessfield Road near Kinnear Road stopping and searching pedestrians and motor cars.

A Chinese constable of the S.M.P. upon noticing a large crowd on Jessfield Road near Connaught Road went to investigate but was pushed away and abused by a member of the Bureau of Public Safety.

61) November 10th

A foreign lady while driving a car North along Jessfield Road knocked down a Chinese boy. Police of the Bureau of Public Safety requested her to proceed to the Connaught Road Sub-Station but upon the lady refusing to comply with their request they took away her driving permit.

62) November 11th

A private of the Worcester Regt. was riding his bicycle fast along Nunnan Road when he collided with and knocked down a Chinese boy who was walking on the Road. A constable of the Bureau of Public Safety took him to the 6th Division Station where he was released after particulars of the accident had been taken.

63) November 12th

An Estonian subject was driving his motor car fast on Nanking Road at 4 p.m. when he collided with a public ricksha and injured two persons. Police of the Bureau of Public Safety took all concerned, including a Russian passenger in the car, to the 7th Sing Sing Sub-Station and later to their Headquarters, Nantao. The foreigners were detained until 11 a.m. on the 13th inst. when a bond was signed by the father of the driver to produce his son at the Bureau of Public Safety Headquarters on the 15th inst. for further enquiries. No action was settled on the driver paying a sum of $20.00 to the injured parties.

A Chinese chauffeur was driving a public lorry out West of Pootung Road when in attempting to avoid a large piece of timber on the road, he swerved to the right side of the road and eventually bore towards the kerbstone where several Chinese coolies were standing. He struck 3 of them and seriously injured one. The driver of the lorry was arrested by police and taken to the 1st Division Station. On arrival there he was charged with dangerous driving. He was remanded until the 14th inst. for enquiries. The injured coolie was removed to the General Hospital where he died on the 13th inst. from his injuries.
pages.zh:
- 11 -

60) 11月9日

一名锡克教巡捕在愚园路与爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）执勤时，因两名公共人力车夫未持有租界执照而逮捕他们，此时受到公安局（Bureau of Public Safety）一名巡捕的干涉。在该市政官员返回岗位后，公安局的这名巡捕用步枪对他进行威胁。

一支由三名穿制服人员和三名便衣人员组成的公安局武装搜查队在金尼尔路（Kinnear Road）附近的极司菲尔路行动，拦截并搜查行人和汽车。

工部局警务处（S.M.P.）的一名中国巡捕注意到康纳特路（Connaught Road）附近的极司菲尔路上有大量人群，前去调查，但被公安局的一名成员推开并辱骂。

61) 11月10日

一名外国女士沿极司菲尔路向北驾车时撞倒了一名中国男孩。公安局警察要求她前往康纳特路分巡捕房，但在该女士拒绝配合他们的要求后，他们没收了她的驾驶执照。

62) 11月11日

伍斯特团（Worcester Regt.）的一名列兵在南浔路（Nunnan Road）快速骑行自行车时，撞倒了一名在路上行走的中国男孩。公安局的一名巡捕将他带至第六巡捕房，在记录事故详情后将其释放。

63) 11月12日

下午4点，一名爱沙尼亚籍人士在南京路快速驾驶汽车，撞上一辆公共人力车，致两人受伤。公安局警察将所有相关人员，包括车内的一名俄罗斯乘客，带至第七新新（Sing Sing）分巡捕房，随后带至其南市总部。外国人被拘留至本月13日上午11点，届时由司机父亲签署保释书，保证于本月15日将其子带至公安局总部接受进一步讯问。在司机向受伤方支付20.00元后，案件未作进一步处理。

一名中国司机驾驶一辆公共卡车沿浦东路向西行驶，在试图避让路面上的一块大木头时，向右转向，最终撞向路边石，几名中国苦力正站在那里。他撞倒了其中三人，并致使一人重伤。卡车司机被警察逮捕并带至第一巡捕房。到达后，他被指控危险驾驶。他被还押候审至本月14日以供查讯。受伤的苦力被送往总医院，于本月13日因伤去世。

pages.en:
- 12 -

64) November 19th
At 7.30 a.m. an American citizen was driving his car West along Nangjao Road when he collided with a Chinese female who was attempting to cross the road. The driver failed to stop when called upon to do so by a Constable of the Bureau of Public Safety who thereupon fired one shot in the air and smashed the window screen of the car with the butt of his pistol as it was passing him. The driver and a lady passenger were taken to the Sicawei Sub-Station where they were later handed over to the Municipal Police.

65) November 22nd
A constable of the Bureau of Public Safety interfered with Municipal Police on Yu Yuen Road who were attempting to arrest a ricksha coolie who had assaulted a Chinese constable of the S.M.P.

66) November 24th
Chapei Police held up a car on Nangjao Road between Warren and Fraser Roads but on seeing that it was occupied by a foreigner allowed the vehicle to proceed.

67) November 26th
A search party of the Bureau of Public Safety operated on Nangjao Road near Fraser Road. The Officer i/c 6th District Police Station explained that in view of the Peking Situation, precautionary measures were being adopted on all roads leading to the Aerodrome.

68) November 27th
Chapei policemen entered a shop, No.199 Scott Road and seized a Mahjong set as well as money which was staked on a game which was in progress. Later that day they arrested one of the players in the game at his home at No.204 Scott Road. This man was later released after being questioned. On representations being made by the Municipal Police to the Inspector in charge of the district, the latter promised to instruct his men not to function on Municipal Roads. In addition he stated that the money and Mahjong set would be returned from whence they were taken.

69) December 28th
A bus of the China General Omnibus Company while proceeding along Nangjao Road near Northfield Road collided with a tramcar. The conductor was taken to the Bureau and the conductor of the Bureau of Public Safety (SMP) Bus was released on representations made by the Municipal Police.
pages.zh:
- 12 -

64) 11月19日
上午7点30分，一名美国公民驾驶汽车沿南桥路（Nangjao Road）向西行驶，撞上了一名试图过马路的中国妇女。当公安局（Bureau of Public Safety）的一名巡捕要求司机停车时，司机未予理会，该巡捕随即朝天开了一枪，并在汽车经过时用枪托砸碎了车窗玻璃。司机和一名女乘客被带至徐家汇分巡捕房，随后被移交给工部局警务处。

65) 11月22日
在愚园路，公安局（Bureau of Public Safety）的一名巡捕干涉工部局警务处警察逮捕一名袭击了工部局警务处（S.M.P.）中国巡捕的人力车夫。

66) 11月24日
闸北警察在威海卫路（Warren Road）与弗雷泽路（Fraser Road）之间的南桥路拦下一辆汽车，但在发现车内有一名外国人后，允许该车辆通行。

67) 11月26日
公安局的一支搜查队在弗雷泽路附近的南桥路行动。第六区巡捕房主管警官解释说，鉴于北京局势，正在通往机场的所有道路上采取预防措施。

68) 11月27日
闸北警察进入斯科特路（Scott Road）199号的一家店铺，查获了一副麻将以及正在进行的游戏中的赌资。当天晚些时候，他们在斯科特路204号的家中逮捕了其中一名玩家。该男子在接受讯问后被释放。经工部局警务处向该区主管督察提出交涉，后者承诺指示其手下不要在市政道路上执法。此外，他表示钱款和麻将将从原处归还。

69) 12月28日
中华汽车公司（China General Omnibus Company）的一辆公共汽车在北菲尔德路（Northfield Road）附近的南桥路行驶时，与一辆电车相撞。售票员被带至公安局，经工部局警务处交涉后，工部局警务处（SMP）公共汽车的售票员获释。

pages.en:
Assault of Municipal Police officer by
members of the Peace Preservation Corps
.........

November 5th

A Chinese constable of the Shanghai
Municipal Police on duty outside Jessfield
Park had occasion to turn back a ricksha
which was proceeding east along Yu Yuen
Road without a Settlement licence. The
passenger in the ricksha abused the Constable
and walked away returning a few minutes later
with three members of the Peace Preservation
Corps. Two of the latter held the arms of the
C.P.C. while the former occupant of the ricksha
slapped the constable's face.
pages.zh:
和平保卫团成员袭击工部局警务处官员
.........

11月5日

工部局警务处（Shanghai Municipal Police）的一名中国巡捕在极司菲尔公园外执勤时，不得不拦回一辆沿愚园路向东行驶且未持有租界执照的人力车。人力车上的乘客辱骂该巡捕后走开，几分钟后带着三名和平保卫团（Peace Preservation Corps）成员返回。其中两人按住工部局警务处（C.P.C.，原文如此，应指S.M.P.）巡捕的双臂，而原人力车乘客则扇了巡捕耳光。

pages.en:
- 13 -

70) December 1st

While a light motor van owned by the Shanghai
Water Works was being driven west along Jessfield
Road by a Chinese chauffeur, he on failing to obey
the traffic signal of a Bureau of Public Safety
policeman in Jessfield Village was arrested and
taken to the 6th Division Sub-Station where he was
cautioned and released.

71) December 6th

A foreign resident of the Yu Shu Gardens, a
private thoroughfare off Tunsin Road, was driving
a motor car in the Gardens when she was stopped
by a member of the Bureau of Public Safety who
informed her that a Chinese licence for the car
was necessary.

A similar incident occurred in the same locality
on December 18 when a hire car licence No.12096 driven
by a Chinese chauffeur was involved. In this case
the driver's licence was taken away by the Bureau of
Public Safety policeman.

70) 12月1日

上海自来水公司（Shanghai Water Works）拥有的一辆轻型机动货车由中国司机驾驶，沿极司菲尔路向西行驶。由于在极司菲尔村（Jessfield Village）未服从公安局（Bureau of Public Safety）警察的交通信号，司机被捕并被带至第六巡捕房分巡捕房，在那里受到警告后获释。

71) 12月6日

敦信路（Tunsin Road）旁一条名为御墅花园（Yu Shu Gardens）的私人通道的一名外籍居民，在花园内驾驶汽车时，被公安局（Bureau of Public Safety）的一名成员拦下，告知其汽车需要中国执照。

12月18日，在同一地点发生了类似事件，涉及一辆车牌号为12096的租赁汽车，由中国司机驾驶。在此案中，司机的驾照被公安局警察没收。

pages.en:
APPENDIX "A"

Summary of Incidents Occurring on
Extra Settlement Roads

January 2 192L.

A constable of the Bureau of Public Safety
prevented a Settlement Police constable from moving
some hawkers who were obstructing the pavement on
Scott Road. On representations being made to the
Sub-Station to which the man was attached the
officer in charge promised to deal with the constable
and transfer him to another area.

January 4

Members of the Bureau refused to allow Municipal
Police to remove the body of a Chinese who had collapsed
and died on Warren Road stating that they had already
made arrangements with the procurator of the Nantao
District Court to hold an inquest on the deceased.

January 7

A Foreigner's car was stopped on Great Western
Road near Chungshan Road by a constable of the
Bureau of Public Safety who informed the Chinese
chauffeur that he would have to obtain a Chinese
licence. The car was then allowed to proceed. The
officer in charge of the 6th Division when interviewed
by Municipal Police stated that the constable was
acting without instructions.

Garbage coolies of the S.M.C. were prevented
from removing refuse from alleyways on Maxwell Road
and Scott Road by coolies of the Bureau of Public
Safety of the City Government. Representations
were made by Municipal Police to the district
Sub-Station concerned and the officer in charge
expressed his regret that the coolies in the employ
of the Chinese Authorities had acted as they did
and promised to take the matter up with the Authorities
concerned.

January 8

Members of the Bureau of Public Safety called
at No.250 Hungjao Road, the residence of a foreign
lady whose car had been involved in an accident
in which a Chinese pedestrian was knocked down on
Hungjao Road the same day and asked the lady or
her son to proceed to Sioquei Sub-Station to sign
a bond that they would be responsible for the payment
of hospital expenses for the injured person.
Municipal Police were called to the premises.

附录“A”

越界筑路地区事件摘要

192L年1月2日。

公安局的一名巡捕阻止了租界警务处的一名巡捕驱离在斯科特路（Scott Road）人行道上阻碍交通的几名小贩。经向该巡捕所属的分巡捕房提出交涉后，负责警官承诺将处理该巡捕并将其调往其他区域。

1月4日

公安局人员拒绝允许工部局警察移走一名在华伦路（Warren Road）倒地身亡的华人尸体，称他们已与南市区法院检察官安排好对死者进行验尸。

1月7日

一辆外侨汽车在大西路（Great Western Road）靠近中山路（Chungshan Road）处被公安局的一名巡捕拦下，该巡捕告知华人司机必须考取中国驾照。随后该车被放行。第六分区负责人在接受工部局警察问询时表示，该巡捕的行动未经指令授权。

市政府公安局的苦力阻止了工部局清洁苦力从麦克斯韦尔路（Maxwell Road）和斯科特路（Scott Road）的小巷中清运垃圾。工部局警察向相关地区的分巡捕房提出交涉，负责警官对受雇于中国当局的苦力如此行事表示遗憾，并承诺将向有关当局提出此事。

1月8日

公安局人员前往虹桥路250号，这是一位外籍女士的住所，其汽车当天在虹桥路卷入一起撞倒一名华人行人的事故。公安局人员要求该女士或其儿子前往小北分巡捕房签署具结书，承诺负责支付伤者的住院费用。工部局警察被召至现场。

After considerable argument all parties proceeded
to the Siccawei Station where matters were amicably
settled after the Municipal Police refused to sign
a bond that the lady in question or her son would be
responsible for the payment of hospital expenses.

January 13

A Chinese chauffeur of the P.W.D. was arrested
by Police of the Bureau of Public Safety on Brennan
Road after an accident in which a Chinese child was
knocked down by the vehicle he was driving. On
representations being made to the 6th Division Station
the case was handed over to the Municipal Police.

January 14

A pony on which a German subject was riding
was accidentally struck by the shaft of a wheelbarrow
on Hankow Road. The pony lashed out kicking the
wheelbarrow coolie and breaking his thigh. The rider
was taken to the Pah Sing Kyung Sub-Station by
members of the Bureau of Public Safety but was
allowed to go after he had given his name and
address and stated that he would be responsible for
the hospital expenses of the injured coolie.

January 27

Officers of the Ying Tsiang Keng Station of the
Bureau of Public Safety effected an arrest of a
Chinese in a straw hut in the Settlement (off Ward
Road) very near to the boundary. The arrested person
was charged with complicity in a larceny and handed
over to the Judicial Department of the Bureau.

经过长时间争论，各方前往徐家汇巡捕房，在工部局警察拒绝签署由该女士或其儿子负责支付伤者住院费用的具结书后，事情得以和平解决。

1月13日

公共工程局（P.W.D.）的一名华人司机在布伦南路（Brennan Road）发生车祸撞倒一名华人儿童后，被公安局警察逮捕。经向第六分区巡捕房提出交涉后，该案移交工部局警察处理。

1月14日

一名德籍人士骑乘的小马在汉口路（Hankow Road）意外被一辆独轮车的车辕撞击。小马尥蹶子踢中独轮车苦力，致其大腿骨折。公安局人员将骑手带至柏星京分巡捕房（Pah Sing Kyung Sub-Station），但在其留下姓名和地址并声明将负责受伤苦力的住院费用后，予以放行。

1月27日

公安局引翔港巡捕房的警官在租界内（近华德路 Ward Road）一处非常靠近边界的草棚内逮捕了一名华人。被捕者被控犯有盗窃罪共犯，并被移交给公安局司法科。
